interview.hardest_part: Real-time boss fights and tight platforming, where timing has to be near frame-accurate while I only see still screenshots and the game keeps moving during thinking.
interview.likely_failure: Moss Grotto itself: mistimed jumps, contact damage, or Moss Mother, because 0.4s holds plus reaction delay make dodges and attack windows unreliable.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Death only respawns at the last bench so exploration progress persists; silk bind restores masks; the opening path is fairly linear; notes carry across restarts within the time budget.
interview.harmful_mechanics: The game continues while I think, so latency is fatal; 0.4s held inputs cannot express short taps, attack cancels, or precise jump heights; no dash at the start; contact damage and hazards punish standing still between decisions; one screenshot hides motion and off-screen threats.
